subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested preview streaming controls, and should any Feishu streaming toggle become writable through the gateway config tool?
rationale: The useful fix crosses both the Feishu channel config contract and the model-to-operator config mutation allowlist, so automation should not pick the permanent config shape or trust boundary alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview controls
options.body: Support Feishu's existing boolean streaming value plus a canonical nested preview object with tool-progress and command-text controls, with doctor/docs/tests preserving current users.

options.title: Only soften exec warnings
options.body: Change the exec warning wording or placement without adding Feishu preview controls, which may reduce confusion but leaves users without the documented suppression knob.

options.title: Broaden gateway config.patch
options.body: Add a low-risk allowlist path for Feishu streaming or tool-progress settings, which improves recoverability but expands model-controlled persistent config writes.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview controls
recommendation.body: Support Feishu's existing boolean streaming value plus a canonical nested preview object with tool-progress and command-text controls, with doctor/docs/tests preserving current users.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Feishu streaming config surface introduced in their merged Feishu Card Kit work.
